hypothesis: Escaped-literal piece assembly can feed certified ASCII views/cache pieces to aggregate joinText, whose fresh result currently has unknown metadata. Quantify first/warm query scan and allocation costs before considering any policy change.
projection_limits: Original lexer-fragment assembly, not full lexer diagnostics/source maps or actual compiler execution. Compiler-arena and ordinary system/K32 are separate configurations.
planned_controls: unknown ASCII read from a file before measured phases
surviving source alias after consuming append
pilot: One short known-ASCII trajectory under system/K32 native, compiler-arena native and system/K32 C ASan+UBSan/generated ASan; no timing claim.
oracles: Independent Python escape decoder and exact printed bytes/codepoint sum/length
Exactly one outer aggregate join, one sizing and one copying visit per piece, total bytes copied equals UTF8 output length
Cold query index build1, warm0, no-query0; empty input still gets a zero-input build
Aliases preserve raw source after consuming source append
System quiescent managed recovery; arena process-lifetime used bytes separately, no recovery claim
instrumentation_limits: Lexical statement phases include compiler ownership/service hooks. Object/data payload requests exclude Rc header overhead and do not measure physical allocator footprint. Index input bytes are scanner input lengths, not CPU instructions/latency. Explicit final drain excluded from phase work.

candidate_preregistered_before_execution.mechanism: During the existing sizing pass, initialize certified_ascii=true and clear it when any part's known character_length differs from byte_length. Return known total length only when the certificate survives; otherwise retain -1. No new scan, allocations, queue service, loop or persistent metadata.
candidate_preregistered_before_execution.count_requirement: Certified ASCII cold query must have zero index builds. Baseline run-0e5yjkpm intentionally fails this requirement after semantic output passes; this is a performance/count red, not a semantic defect.
added_controls: Malformed unknown UTF8 traps lazily with the same exit1 diagnostic
Preexisting object/frame/chunk debt at a deterministic private detach boundary, same public join and ordered request/copy/service events
Exact requested bytes, hook offerings, actual queued units and quiescent recovery equivalence
candidate_preregistered_before_execution.no_query_cost: One additional certificate predicate per fragment in the existing sizing pass, including no-query inputs; zero extra fragment visits and zero extra allocation/service hooks. No CPU speedup/slowdown claim without separate paired observations.
candidate_preregistered_before_execution.scope: Production files stay frozen. Ordinary and compiler-arena uncertified proof states remain conservative. Empty vacuous certificate is permitted; unknown/malformed/Unicode never guessed ASCII.
